newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks surge up on pre-election rally.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks surge up on pre-election rally.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose sharply on Sunday in a rally before Monday's national elections amid hopes that pro-business politician Nawaz Sharif may win the vote, dealers said.
They said the index could surge higher on Tuesday if Sharif gets a convincing parliamentary majority.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 63.05 points, or 4.11 percent, to end at 1,597.26. Gainers led losers 188 to 30. Turnover fell to 39.73 million shares from 43.74 million in the previous session on Thursday.
